Internal memo — Invoice #4533 (LED fixtures, $9,900, supplier AR)

Paid $4,950 today per authority. Supplier is also asserting a $150 late fee, unsupported by anything on our side — not accepted, flagged for manager review. No agreement reached on final balance date or fee; both remain open/conditional pending approvals on both sides. Action items: escalate late fee to manager for decision; confirm October 11 payment stays on track regardless of supplier's response; watch for supplier's finance manager reply, which may reopen the date discussion.
